independence: No report or scoring implementation imported; no REPORT.md/report.json/figures read by capture.
label: fresh held-out extension, run after the freeze; not the pre-registered sealed claim

evidence.allocation_rank_limit: Rank/type and exact unique ranks are checked against committed raw draw; canonical public-facts ordering is not recomputed without opening map payloads.
evidence.closed_world_limit: Published open logs show only registered ext-1 maps. This cannot detect unlogged file access, unrecorded prior seeds/digests or forbidden sealed payload contents; no map payload was opened by this verifier. Freeze and seed census coverage are independently hash-bound attestations, not a new execution of their original census/full-weight verifier.

coverage_limits: A closed-world statement about recorded external identity metadata, not unknown unrecorded payload contents.
Forbidden raw trees are not entered. Their public corpus/envelope manifests and requested lists are explicitly covered.
Plan/job/row payloads and symlinks are not opened. Identity values recorded only there are outside directly auditable metadata coverage.
Synthetic test workspaces and tool environments are excluded; their fake seeds are not experimental cohorts.
All hexadecimal metadata values are retained conservatively; an unknown recorded canonical identity outside selected metadata cannot be certified.
